error.message: Nuk të lejohet ta bësh këtë.

Forbidden.description: Who is asking is known, and may not: a suspended account whose sign-in code came back right.

Internal.description: Anything else that ended the request, a database's error among them: logged in full, answered without its details. Try again.

error.message: Ajo që kërkove nuk u gjet.

NotFound.description: Nothing there, or nothing the caller may see: what isn't theirs answers so.

error.message: Shumë kërkesa njëra pas tjetrës. Provo përsëri pas pak.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests too quickly: `retry_after` and `Retry-After` say in how many seconds to try again, where that is known.

Retry-After.description: The seconds to wait, where they are known, as `retry_after` says them

error.message: Hyr në llogari për të vazhduar.

Unauthorized.description: No bearer token where the route needs one, or one no good session has (wrong, expired, or its account closed or suspended): sign in again. `WWW-Authenticate: Bearer` says how.

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer`: the scheme that would sign the request in

fields.body: Trupi i kërkesës nuk është JSON i vlefshëm.

error.message: Disa fusha nuk janë në rregull.

Validation.description: What was sent isn't right: `fields` names each field the request named with what is wrong with it (`body` for a body that isn't JSON, wasn't sent as JSON or lacks a field); a refusal that is no field's says so in `message` alone.

Action.description:
What a seller can do to their listing from its page, by where it stands (domain::Status, the
rules its routes on the pages and db::ListingAction go by): edit, pause, resume, sell, reserve,
unreserve, renew or delete, each its route (`POST /listings/{no}/<action>`, `PUT` and `DELETE
/listings/{no}`).

Activity.description: When someone was last on the site, by Albania's clock: today, within the week (from yesterday to six days ago), within the month (from a week to thirty days ago), or longer ago.

AlertsBody.description: What `PUT /searches/{id}/alerts` takes: whether the search tells of new listings.

AreaPriceDto.description:
What a square metre of a property on sale costs (domain::listing::area_price), against its
zone's average (domain::listing::zone_price).

per_m2.description: Its price over its area, in its currency, to the whole euro or lek.

oneOf.description:
"below" the average by 200 € or more, "same", "near" within 200 € or "above" it by 200 €
or more; none without an average.

zone_per_m2.description:
What one costs in its zone on average, among the zone's sales in its category, in its
currency, rounded likewise; none outside a zone with an average, or for a starting price.

AttributeDto.description: One of a listing's properties, as data, and as its page words it in the language asked for.

date.description: A date, as ISO 8601 has it: "2026-10-04".

key.description: One of the category's key facts, which its cards show too.

label.description:
Its name as the listing's category gives it ("Kilometrazhi"), and as an English page says it
("Mileage").

multi.description: Whether it takes several values (a car's options, a flat's amenities), each an option.

number.description:
A number, as text, every digit it has, with its unit as the database keeps it and as an
English page says it after this number ("muaj", "months"; "month" after a 1).

options.description: The options chosen: a choice's one, a multi-select's each, in their order.

shown.description:
Its value as its page shows it, in the language asked for ("148 000 km", "Naftë", "Jo",
"04.10.2026"; pluribus-services' listings::shown): one, or a multi-select's each.

text.description: A text someone typed, as they typed it.

AttributeOptionDto.description:
An option chosen: its code, as the filters and the form name it, and its label, in Albanian and
as an English page says it (the catalogue's, not the database's own label_i18n); in the OpenAPI
document `AttributeOptionDto`, reference.rs having an `OptionDto` of its own.

Bound.description:
A bound as validation_json writes it: a whole number as one (1900), any other with its
decimals (0.5).

CarPriceDto.description:
A car's price against what cars of its model and year ask (two years either side), as its
page's bubble says it (domain::listing::car_verdict, pluribus-services' listings::CarPrices).

median.description:
The median, in the listing's currency, rounded as its page rounds it (to the hundred euros,
the ten thousand lekë).

percent.description:
Its price as a share of the median, both in euros, in whole percent, the half rounded up
(domain::listing::car_percent): what the verdict weighs, unrounded; 93 for a price 7 % under
it, 120 for one 20 % over.

text.description:
What such cars ask, in a sentence, in the language asked for: "Volkswagen Golf 2014–2018 në
shitje: shumica kërkojnë 9 500–11 400 €, mesatarja 10 300 €."

oneOf.description:
How its price compares: "good" 15 % or more under the median, "near" within 15 %, "above"
15 % or more over it; null under half of it, which says only that the price is likely wrong
(its page then shows no bubble).

CarVerdict.description: How a car's price compares with what cars of its model and year ask: good (15 % or more under their median), near (within 15 % of it), or above (15 % or more over it).

CardDto.description:
A listing as its card shows it, from the row the pages' cards are made from (`db::ListingCard`):
what the app draws a card with, and the stand-in its page opens with while the rest comes.

oneOf.description: What state the thing is in, in the categories that ask: NEW, LIKE_NEW, USED or FOR_PARTS.

deal.description:
Whether its page is laid out as a car's or a property's, its photos 4:3 on a phone, which the
stand-in frames them in too.

details.description:
Its category's card properties in their order, as data, with their words in English as the
English pages say them (`DetailDto`), which the app words in its language as the pages do.

distance_m.description: How far it is from the map's pin, in metres, in a query with one (lat, lng).

good_price.description:
A clear bargain: a car well under what cars of its model and year ask ("Çmim i mirë"), its
price not lately dropped, which `price.was` says enough of.

heading.description:
A car's title as its seller wrote it, where `title` was made: what its page heads itself
with; none for the others.

highlighted.description: Whether a promotion highlights it now: its card stands out wherever it shows.

kind.description: What it offers or asks for: SELL, BUY, RENT, WANTED_RENT, SERVICE or JOB.

no.description: Its number, which its page goes by.

oneOf.description: Its cover photo; none for a listing without photos.

place.description: Where it is: the zone and the town ("Blloku, Tiranë"), or the town; none without a place.

promoted.description: Whether a promotion features it now: the pages put it at the top of the results, marked.

seller_kind.description: Who sells it: a private seller ("user"), or a business ("business").

status.description: Where it stands: ACTIVE; among those seen lately, RESERVED or SOLD too, which its card says.

title.description:
What its card says: a car's made from what the car is ("Volkswagen Golf 7, 2016, naftë"),
another's as its seller wrote it.

views.description: How many times its page was seen this week: on `/home`'s most seen alone.

when.description: When it was posted, or last brought up again, by which the newest come first.

CardPage.description: A page of a list of `CardDto`, and where the next one starts.

items.description: The page's items, in the list's order

next.description: Where the next page starts, which the app sends back as `after` with the same query; null on the last page

CategoryDto.description: A category, with those under it (`GET /categories`).

allow_listings.description:
Whether listings go into it: not into one that only groups others ("Automjete"), whose
listings go into one of its `children`.

children.description: The categories under it, in their order, each likewise.

default_currency.description: The currency its posting form starts with: "EUR" for cars and property, "ALL" for most.

listing_types.description:
The kinds of listing it takes, of SELL, BUY, RENT, WANTED_RENT, SERVICE and JOB: what its
posting form offers, and its filters where there are several.

name.description: Its name in Albanian, one word where it can be, as the pages show it: "Makina".

name_en.description: Its name as an English page shows it: "Cars".

parent_slug.description: The category it is under; none for a main one.

slug.description: What names it in an address and a filter: "makina" (/c/makina, `category=makina`).

uses_condition.description: Whether its listings say what condition the thing is in (new, used...).

CategoryNameDto.description:
A category by its slug, which `GET /listings` takes as `category`, and its name in Albanian and
as an English page says it: one of those above a listing's (`ListingDto::category`), or one
the suggestions lead to.

Channel.description: How a code went: whatsapp, email, or log, where its channel isn't set up (the server's log has it, as in development).

CityDto.description:
A town listings go into (`GET /cities`): a municipality, named after its main town. A place's
name is the same in English.

county.description: Its county, which the filters list the towns under: "Tiranë".

latitude.description: Its point, where its listings stand on the map without one of their own.

slug.description: What names it in a filter: "tirane" (`city=tirane`).

zones.description:
The parts of the town people name, which a property listing can say it is in (Blloku), by
name; none for most towns.

Client.description: What a session is for: web (the pages), or the phone app on ios or android.

CloseRequest.description: `DELETE /me`'s body: the word that says it is meant.

confirm.description: FSHI, in any case, or the word of the request's language (DELETE in English).

CodeRequest.description:
`POST /auth/code`'s body: a phone number or an e-mail address, as people type them ("069 123
4567", "Ana@Example.com"), and the name for an account it makes, if it makes one.

code.description:
In test mode alone (`SIGN_IN_CODES_ON_SCREEN`), the code itself, as the pages show it
then; left out otherwise.

code_id.description: What the code waits under, which `/auth/verify` takes back with it.

sent_to.description: Where it went, as the pages show it: "+355 69 *** **67", "a***@example.com".

via.description:
How it went: "whatsapp", "email", or "log" where its channel isn't set up (as in
development, where the server's log has it).

Condition.description: What state a thing is in, in the categories that ask: NEW, LIKE_NEW, USED or FOR_PARTS.

ContactCodeRequest.description:
`POST /me/contacts/verify`'s body: the code's id, as `/me/contacts` gave it, and the code as
typed (its digits are what count).

ContactDto.description: How a listing's seller can be reached.

kinds.description:
What `POST /listings/{no}/contact` reveals: ["phone"], or ["email"] for a seller who signed
in by e-mail and shows no number; none once the listing is off the site or sold, or where
its seller shows neither.

revealed.description:
Whether the number or the address is here: never, so that a reveal is asked for, and
counted.

ContactKind.description: A kind of contact: a phone number, or an e-mail address.

ContactRequest.description: `POST /me/contacts`' body: a phone number or an e-mail address, as people type them.

ContactRevealedDto.description: `POST /listings/{no}/contact`: the seller's number or address, revealed.

email.description: The address, of a seller who shows no number.

whatsapp_url.description:
Beside a number WhatsApp can reach (not an Albanian landline), the address that opens a chat
with it, a first message naming the listing typed in the language asked for.

blocked_by_me.description:
Whether the user's side blocked the other, who can't write to them any more, nor the user to
them until they let them again (`/unblock`)...

blocked_me.description: ...and whether the other side blocked the user's.

can_write.description: Whether the user may write in it now: neither side blocked the other...

closed.description:
Whether the listing takes no new conversations now: down, sold, off the site, its messages
turned off, or gone. This one goes on all the same, as on the pages, the listing's
`status_label` saying what became of it.

oneOf.description: The listing it is about; none once it is gone for good.

messages.description: Its messages, the oldest first: its latest 300, or with `after` those after that one.

oneOf.description:
For one of a store's people, the store whose conversation it is ("Për Auto Durrësi" on the
page); none otherwise.

...and where they may not, why, as a message sent anyway would be refused: its code
("blocked", "blocked_by") and what it says, in the language asked for.

CopiesDto.description: A photo's copies (pluribus-services' media::COPIES), as the pages offer them to a browser.

card.description:
The cards' copy, 600 px on its shorter side, as WebP with the query of the rules it is made
by; for a photo kept before WebP, its card-sized JPEG.

card_avif.description: The cards' three as AVIF, lighter where it is shown; none for a photo kept before WebP.

full.description:
The whole photo, 1 600 px on its longer side, as WebP; for a photo kept before, the photo
itself.

jpeg.description: The whole photo as JPEG, as link previews and browsers without WebP get it.

middle.description: The middle copy, 1 200 px on its longer side; none for a photo no bigger, or kept before.

small.description:
The small and the mini copies, 400 and 300 px on the shorter side, as WebP; none for a
photo kept before WebP.

CountDto.description:
How many listings a query finds, counted up to a limit: past it, `n` is the limit and `more`
says there are more ("1 000+").

CountsDto.description:
What the app's badges count (`GET /counts`), each as the pages' own JSON counts it, by the same
function.

messages.description:
The conversations with messages the user hasn't read (db::unread_conversations), as the
messages button counts them (/mesazhet/numri).

notifications.description:
Their notifications of the last db::NOTIFICATIONS_DAYS they haven't read
(db::unread_notifications), as the account button counts them (/lajmerimet/numri)...

own.description:
...and of those, the ones about their own listings (expiring, expired, promoted:
NotificationKind::OWN_LISTING), which the account button's dot stands for.

price_drops.description:
The price drops of the listings they keep they haven't seen (db::price_drops, 20 at most),
as the heart counts them (/te-ruajturat/numrat)...

searches.description: ...and their saved searches with alerts they haven't seen (db::unseen_search_alerts).

Currency.description: A currency a price is asked or filtered in: EUR or ALL (lekë).

DataType.description: What a property's values are: TEXT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, DATE, SELECT (one of its options) or MULTISELECT (any of them).

DetailDto.description:
One of a card's properties, as data (db::CardDetail), with its words as the English pages say
them, from the catalogue (i18n/en/), as pluribus-web's CardDetailExt::shown and
format::attribute_number word them, and not the database's own English for a choice
(label_i18n), which differs from it for many. One of: a number (as text, every digit it has),
with its unit; a choice's label; a text someone typed, as they typed it; a box ticked (`flag`),
with the property's name. What it hasn't is left out.

flag.description:
A box's: ticked, which a card shows by the property's name (`name`, and `name_en` as an
English page says it).

label.description:
A choice's label ("Naftë"), and as an English page says it ("Diesel"; the label itself where
the catalogue has no English for it).

number.description: A number, as text, every digit it has: "148000".

unit.description:
The number's unit as the database keeps it ("km", "muaj"), and as an English page says it
after this number ("km", "months"; "month" after a 1).

DeviceRequest.description: `PUT /me/devices`' body: the app's platform, `ios` or `android`, and the token Firebase gave it.

token.description: The token Firebase Cloud Messaging gave the app on the device, 1 to 4096 characters.

DropDto.description:
A price lowered lately (domain::listing::price_drop): from what, to what, and by how many
percent, whole, 1 at least ("−7%"). The page doesn't know when; the 30 days before it
changed are what `from` is the lowest of.

ErrorBody.description: An error as the envelope gives it.

fields.description: A validation error's fields, each with its message; on other errors, none (left out).

message.description: What went wrong, in the request's language.
examples: Disa fusha nuk janë në rregull.

retry_after.description:
For a request that came too soon, in how many seconds to try again, where that is known
(`Retry-After` says it too); otherwise none (left out).

ErrorCode.description: Why a request failed, the same in every language, for the app to act on: unauthorized (401), forbidden (403), not_found (404), validation (422), rate_limited (429) or internal (500).

ErrorEnvelope.description: What a failed request answers: its error, the envelope's one member.

FieldDto.description:
One of a category's properties, as its filters offer it or as its posting form asks for it
(`GET /categories/{slug}/fields`): a car's make, a flat's rooms.

allow_other.description:
Whether the seller may give an option the list lacks ("Tjetër"), as for a car's make and
model: in the posting form; never in the filters.

code.description:
What names it, and its value in a filter or a listing: "vehicle_make"
(`vehicle_make=VOLKSWAGEN`, `vehicle_year_min=2010`).

data_type.description: What its values are: TEXT, NUMBER, BOOLEAN, SELECT or MULTISELECT.

label.description: Its name in Albanian, the category's own name for it where it has one: "Marka".

label_en.description: Its name as an English page shows it: "Brand".

options.description: Its options, a SELECT's or a MULTISELECT's, in their order; none for the others.

order.description:
Its place among the category's properties, from 0, in the category's order, which the
answer is in too.

parent_code.description:
The property among the category's whose options this one's each belong under: a car's
model, under its make ("vehicle_make"); none for most.

required.description: Whether the category asks every listing for it.

row.description:
Whether its filter is one of the dropdowns of the category's results page's row after
Filtrat, as the pages put them there with no filter on (pluribus-services'
`ParsedFilters::row`): of those buyers narrow by most, its dropdowns, boxes and years, as
many as the row has room for. Never the posting form's.

row_order.description:
Its place in that row, from 0, where it is in it: the places the fields leave are the row's
others', the price's (fourth, or before the last of fewer, after a lone one) and, where the
category offers them, the kind of listing's (first in property, else last) and the
condition's (Makina's: its make 0, its model 1, its year 2, the price 3 and its fuel 4;
Prona's: the kind 0, the price 1 and its features 2); null for the rest.

unit.description: A number's unit, as the pages write it ("km", "inç"); none for most.

unit_en.description: The unit as an English page writes it ("km", "in").

oneOf.description:
The bounds the posting form holds a number to, as the property keeps them
(`attributes.validation_json`, whose `min` and `max` the form reads): `{"min": 1900}`,
`{"min": 25, "max": 10000}`, `{}` for none; null for the filters, which hold to none.

FieldOptionDto.description:
One of a property's options (`FieldDto::options`); in the OpenAPI document `FieldOptionDto`,
listing.rs having an `OptionDto` of its own.

code.description: What names it as the property's value, in a filter or a listing: "VOLKSWAGEN".

label_en.description: Its label as an English page shows it: "Diesel".

parent_option.description:
For a property that depends on another (`FieldDto::parent_code`), the code of the other's
option it belongs under: a Golf's make, "VOLKSWAGEN"; none for the others.

FieldsFor.description:
Which of a category's properties `GET /categories/{slug}/fields` gives (`?for=`): those its
filters offer (filters), or those its posting form asks for (form).

FilterDto.description: A filter as a query string's pair: a property's code and one of its options' codes.

GoneDto.description:
A listing kept that no one can open any more (`db::GoneListing`): its seller took it down for a
while or for good, it expired, or the reports or the moderators took it off.

status.description: Where it stands, as the database spells it: PAUSED, DELETED, EXPIRED, SUSPENDED or REJECTED.

why.description:
Why it isn't on the site, as /te-ruajturat says it (`Status::gone_label`), in the language
asked for: "Çaktivizuar nga shitësi", "U fshi", "Skadoi", "Hequr nga faqja".

HealthDto.description: `GET /health`: the server and its database answer.

HomeDto.description: `GET /home`: the front page's rows, as the welcome page has them.

categories.description: The main categories, in the welcome page's order.

for_you.description: Whether `recommended` is those recommended for the caller, rather than the newest.

most_viewed.description: The listings seen the most this week ("Më të klikuarat"), eight at most, each with its views.

recommended.description:
The first page of those recommended for the caller ("Të rekomanduara për ty"), or for a
caller with too few like what they looked at, of the newest ("Njoftimet më të reja"), as
`for_you` says; its `next` goes to `/listings` as `after` for the page after it.

seen_lately.description:
The listings the caller saw lately ("Shikuar së fundmi"), of the numbers `seen` named, in
their order, those still on the site.

InboxDto.description: A conversation as the inbox lists it (`GET /conversations`).

blocked.description: Whether the user's side blocked the other.

oneOf.description: The listing it is about; none once it is gone for good.

preview.description:
Its latest message as the inbox shows it: its start on one line (messaging::preview), after
"Ti: " ("You: ") where the user wrote it, or a colleague's name where another of the store's
people did.

oneOf.description:
For one of a store's people, the store whose conversation it is, which the inbox names
beside the buyer; none otherwise.

unread.description: How many messages from the other side the user hasn't read.

Language.description: A language the site speaks: sq (Albanian) or en (English).

ListingCategoryDto.description:
A listing's category (`ListingDto::category`): its slug, which `GET /listings` takes as
`category`, its name in Albanian and as an English page says it, what its page is titled by,
and those above it, the main one first, as its page's breadcrumb goes up through them.

path.description: The categories above it, the main one first (Automjete over Makina); none for a main one.

ListingDto.description: `GET /listings/{no}`: a listing as its page shows it.

actions.description:
What its seller can do to it, by where it stands, as its page's buttons and "Njoftimet e
mia"'s go by it (domain::Status): any of edit, pause, resume, sell, reserve, unreserve,
renew and delete; none for anyone else.

oneOf.description:
For a property on sale at a price of its own with an area, what a square metre of it costs,
against its zone's average where its zone has one.

attributes.description:
Its properties, in its category's order, those its page lists (a car's make and model, its
key facts, its options, all of them).

oneOf.description:
For a car up for sale at a price, what cars of its model and year ask, as its page's bubble
says; none where too few do, or for anything else.

category.description: Its category, and the way up from it, as its page's breadcrumb goes.

oneOf.description: What state the thing is in, in the categories that ask: NEW, LIKE_NEW, USED or FOR_PARTS.

deal.description:
Whether its page is laid out as a car's or a property's (domain::listing::MAPPED): its
photos a mosaic, its key facts in a row, where it is on a map (`place.point`).

description.description: As its seller wrote it, its lines as they are.

heading.description:
A car's title as its seller wrote it, where `title` was made: what its page heads its
description with; none for the others.

kind.description: What it offers or asks for: SELL, BUY, RENT, WANTED_RENT, SERVICE or JOB.

oneOf.description:
For something on sale at a price of its own worth borrowing for, what the page's loan
calculator starts from; the years and the interest are the app's to ask.

no.description: Its number, which its page and these routes go by.

own.description:
Whether the caller is its seller (a private seller's own, or a store's people who post for
it), whose page offers them their buttons (`actions`).

published_at.description: When it went up, and when it expires if it does.

status.description:
Where it stands: ACTIVE, RESERVED or SOLD for anyone; PAUSED, EXPIRED, PENDING_REVIEW,
SUSPENDED or REJECTED for its seller and the moderators, who alone see it then.

status_note.description:
What its page says over it to those who see it while nobody else does, or nobody yet
(domain::Status::page_note), in the language asked for: that it waits for a moderator,
that it is off the site with its seller's account or for its reports, that the moderators
took it off (to its seller with their reason), that its seller paused it or that it
expired (to its seller with the button that puts it back); none for one on the site.

title.description:
What its page calls it: a car's made from what the car is ("Volkswagen Golf 1.6, 2016"),
another's as its seller wrote it.

views.description:
How many times its page was seen, every day's views added up, as its page says under its
heart; none before the first.

order.description:
The order of its photos, by their ids, those it keeps and those `photo_ids` adds, the first
the cover; those it leaves out follow, as they were.

removed.description: The listing's photos taken out, by their ids; one that isn't the listing's counts for nothing.

ListingEditDto.description:
What `PUT /listings/{no}` takes: the listing's fields as `POST /listings` does, the photos it
takes out, and the order of all of them.

ListingHeadDto.description:
The listing a conversation is about, as its head and the inbox show it (pluribus-web's
ListingHead).

no.description: Its number, which its page goes by.

photo.description: Its cover's card-sized copy, its address absolute; none for a listing without photos.

status_label.description:
What became of it, once it is no longer simply up, in the language asked for: "Rezervuar",
"Shitur" ("Dhënë me qira" for a rental), "Jo më në faqe" (messaging::listing_label); none
while it is up.

ListingInputDto.description:
What `POST /listings` takes, and `PUT /listings/{no}` with what an edit adds (`ListingEditDto`):
a listing's fields, by the posting form's names for them, its properties by their codes, and its
photos by their uploads' ids. A field left out is as the form's left empty, and what is wrong
with it is said under its name: each field's own default, rather than the struct's, which the
OpenAPI document would write into the schema, an enum's "" among them.

category.description: The category's slug ("makina"), one listings go into, not one that only groups others.

city.description: The town's slug ("tirane"), and for a property a zone of it ("blloku").

oneOf.description: What state the thing is in, where the category asks: NEW, LIKE_NEW, USED or FOR_PARTS.

cover.description:
The cover, one of `photo_ids` (or, on an edit, of the listing's photos): first, whatever
their order.

currency.description: EUR or ALL; any other is euros.

description.description: 10 to 5 000 characters, two links at most.

listing_type.description:
What it offers or asks for, one the category takes: SELL, BUY, RENT, WANTED_RENT, SERVICE or
JOB (a category of one kind is of that kind whatever this says).

name.description: The name buyers see, 60 characters at most; none for the account's.

photo_ids.description:
Its photos, by the ids of the caller's uploads (`POST /photos`), in their order, MAX_PHOTOS at
most with those an edit keeps.

oneOf.description:
For a property or a car, its own point on the map, within 40 km of its town; none for its
town's.

price.description:
The amount, a number (or its digits as text, "9500.50"), above 0, for a fixed or negotiable
price; kept to the cent.

price_type.description: FIXED, NEGOTIABLE, FREE or ON_REQUEST; FIXED without one.

properties.description:
The category's properties (`GET /categories/{slug}/fields?for=form`), by code: a value as
text or a number ("VOLKSWAGEN", 2016, "148 000"), several for a multi-select (["ABS",
"NAVIGATION"]), true for a box ticked, and for a list's "Tjetër" the name typed,
{"other": "Zastava"} (or as the form sends it, "__other__" with the name under
"<code>_other").

store.description:
"Posto si": the store it is posted as, by its slug, one the caller posts for; none for their
own. A new listing's alone, as on the pages.

ListingPhotoDto.description: One of a listing's photos, each copy's address absolute, as the pages name them.

cover.description: Whether it is the cover, the cards' photo: the first.

id.description: Its id, by which an edit orders and removes it.

placeholder.description:
A tiny blurred copy as a data: URI, to show while one comes; none for a photo kept before
WebP.

width.description:
The whole photo's size in pixels, which every copy has the shape of; none where it isn't
known.

ListingPriceDto.description: A listing's price, as its page says it.

amount.description: The amount, as text, every digit it has; none for a price on request, nor for a free one.

oneOf.description: The drop, as the pill beside its page's price says it.

eur_rate.description: What a unit of its currency is worth in euros, for the app to say it in the other currency.

per_month.description: Whether the amount is a month's: a rent's, or a job's pay.

type.description: How the price is meant: FIXED, NEGOTIABLE, FROM, FREE or ON_REQUEST.

was.description: What it was, when it dropped lately (by a hundredth or more, within the last 30 days).

ListingType.description: What a listing offers or asks for: SELL (on sale), BUY (someone wants to buy), RENT (for rent, its price a month's), WANTED_RENT (someone wants to rent), SERVICE, or JOB (its price a month's pay).

ListingsDto.description:
`GET /listings`: a page of the listings a query finds, where the next starts, and how many it
finds.

next.description: Sent back as `after`, with the same query, for the next page; null on the last.

LoanDto.description: What the page's loan calculator starts from.

down_percent.description:
The down payment it takes for given, a percentage of the price, as Albania's banks ask for
a used car (domain::listing::LOAN_DOWN_PERCENT); the loan is the rest.

MainCategoryDto.description:
A main category, as `/home` lists them: its slug, which `/listings` takes as `category`, and its
name in Albanian and in English.

MeDto.description:
The signed-in user (`GET /me`): who they are, from their session (`db::SessionUser`), and their
language and since when they have had an account, from the account (`db::account_settings`).

display_name.description: The name they show by, as they gave it ("Përdorues" until they give one).

email.description: Their e-mail address, if their account has one.

phone.description: Their phone number, as +355691234567, if their account has one.

preferred_language.description: The language their e-mails are in: "sq" or "en".

MessageBody.description:
What the routes that write take: `{"body": "…"}`, the message, which goes without space
around it (messaging::tidy).

examples: Përshëndetje, a është ende në shitje?

MessageDto.description: A message, as a conversation shows it.

author.description:
For one of a store's people, the colleague who sent it, where it wasn't them; none
otherwise.

body.description: What it says, as it was sent.

id.description: A UUIDv7, which sorts as it was sent: what `after` and `up_to` name it by.

kind.description:
What kind of message it is, as the database spells it: TEXT, what someone wrote, the only
kind a conversation shows (the schema has room for others, SYSTEM among them, the site's
own, which nothing writes yet).

mine.description: Whether the user's side sent it: they, or another of the store's people they are one of.

MyListingDto.description: One of the caller's listings, as "Njoftimet e mia" shows it (`GET /me/listings`).

actions.description:
Its seller's buttons, by where it stands (domain::Status), as on its page (`ListingDto`):
any of edit, pause, resume, sell, reserve, unreserve, renew and delete, each its route here.

kind.description: What it offers or asks for: SELL, BUY, RENT, WANTED_RENT, SERVICE or JOB.

no.description: Its number, which its page and these routes go by.

photo.description: Its first photo's card copy, its address absolute; none without photos.

promotions.description: The promotions on it now, the soonest to end first.

published_at.description: When it went up, and when it expires if it does.

status.description:
Where it stands: ACTIVE, RESERVED, SOLD, PAUSED, EXPIRED, PENDING_REVIEW (or DRAFT, waiting
for its code), SUSPENDED or REJECTED.

status_label.description:
What its row says of it once it is no longer simply up, in the language asked for:
"Rezervuar", "Shitur" ("Dhënë me qira" for a rental), "Skaduar", "Në pritje",
"Çaktivizuar"... (domain::Status::seller_label); none while it is up.

status_note.description:
What its page says over it to its seller, while nobody else sees it, in the language asked
for: that it waits for a moderator, that its reports took it off the site, why the moderators
took it off, that it is paused or expired, with the button that puts it back
(domain::Status::page_note); none while it is on the site.

title.description: What its page calls it: a car's made from what the car is, another's as its seller wrote it.

views.description:
What it drew, all along and over the last seven days: its page seen, its seller's number or
address shown, and kept by how many (those kept in the week).

NewSearchBody.description:
What `POST /searches` takes: a page the pages' "Ruaj kërkimin" keeps, its path (/search, or a
category's, /c/makina) and its filters' query string, in the pages' vocabulary, as
`/listings` takes it ("city=tirane&vehicle_fuel=DIESEL"; a "?" before it is left out).

NoticesDto.description:
What the account hears of (`GET` and `PUT /me/notices`; db::NoticePreferences), named as
"Cilësimet" names its boxes: the messages left unread ("Mesazhet që nuk i ke lexuar"), the
prices that drop of the listings it keeps ("Çmimet që bien"), its saved searches' new listings
("Kërkimet e ruajtura"), and whether by e-mail too ("Edhe me email"), which only an account
with an address has a box for. All on until it says otherwise.

NotificationDto.description: A notification, as the app lists it (`GET /notifications`).

body.description:
What it says under its title: a message notice's start of the message, as its writer wrote
it; an invitation into a store's, the role it offers and what that lets one do, in the
language asked for; none for the rest.

conversation_id.description: The conversation a message notice is about.

id.description: A UUIDv7, which sorts as it was made: what `after` and `up_to` name it by.

kind.description:
What it is about: PRICE_DROP, SAVED_SEARCH, NEW_MESSAGE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, PROMOTED or
STORE_INVITE.

listing_no.description:
The listing it is about (a price drop, an expiry, a promotion), by its number, while the
user may open its page: up or sold, or theirs and not deleted.

read.description:
Whether the user has read it: shown it, here or on /lajmerimet, or seen what it is about
(a conversation read, a price drop on /te-ruajturat, a listing renewed).

search_id.description:
The saved search whose new listings it tells of, while the user keeps it; where they keep
it no more, the page leads to their saved searches.

title.description:
What it says, whole, in the language asked for: "Çmimi ra: Laptop Lenovo ThinkPad T14",
"Price drop: Laptop Lenovo ThinkPad T14".
examples: Çmimi ra: Laptop Lenovo ThinkPad T14

NotificationKind.description: What a notification is about: PRICE_DROP (a listing kept dropped its price), SAVED_SEARCH (a saved search has new listings), NEW_MESSAGE (a message waits unread), EXPIRING and EXPIRED (one of the user's listings), PROMOTED (a moderator promoted one of them), or STORE_INVITE (the user is asked into a store).

NotificationPage.description: A page of a list of `NotificationDto`, and where the next one starts.

items.description: The page's items, in the list's order

next.description: Where the next page starts, which the app sends back as `after` with the same query; null on the last page

NotificationsSeenBody.description:
What `POST /notifications/seen` reads; in the OpenAPI document `NotificationsSeenBody`, saved.rs
having a `SeenBody` of its own.

up_to.description: The latest of the unread notifications the app showed, by its id.

OptionSuggestionDto.description:
A make, model or brand the words name (`SuggestionsDto::options`), a search by its filters in
the category most of its listings are in: "Volkswagen Golf" in Makina, `category=makina&
vehicle_make=VOLKSWAGEN&vehicle_model=VOLKSWAGEN_GOLF`.

filters.description:
The filters that find it there, each a property's code and an option's, as `GET /listings`
takes them: `vehicle_make=VOLKSWAGEN`, then `vehicle_model=VOLKSWAGEN_GOLF`.

name.description: What it is called: a model after its make, "Volkswagen Golf"; a brand, "Samsung".

OtherDto.description: The other side of a conversation.

id.description: A person's account, or a store's, by its id.

name.description:
Their name as the pages show it: as they gave it, or the one the site gives in the language
asked for ("Përdorues", "User", until they give one); a store's own.

slug.description: A store's address, its page's (/biznes/{slug}); none for a person.

OtherKind.description: Who the other side of a conversation is: a person (user), or a store (business).

OwnPriceDto.description: A listing's price, as its row on "Njoftimet e mia" says it.

amount.description: The amount, as text, every digit it has; none for a price on request, nor for a free one.

per_month.description: Whether the amount is a month's: a rent's, or a job's pay.

type.description: How the price is meant: FIXED, NEGOTIABLE, FROM, FREE or ON_REQUEST.

PhotoDto.description: A card's photo, every address absolute.

card.description:
The card's copy (600 px on its shorter side for a photo kept as WebP, as `card_webp`), or
for a photo kept before WebP its card-sized JPEG.

card_webp.description: The card's copy as WebP, for a photo kept as WebP; none for one kept before.

full.description:
The whole photo, 1600 px on its longer side: for a photo kept as WebP its JPEG copy, as link
previews get it; the photo itself for one kept before.

placeholder.description:
A tiny blurred copy as a data: URI, to show while the card's comes; none for a photo kept
before WebP.

width.description:
The whole photo's size in pixels, for the card's frame before it comes; none where it isn't
known.

PhotosForm.description: A listing's photos, before the listing: the whole body 64 MB at most.

photos.description: The photos, in their order, the field repeated for each

items.description: A photo, JPEG, PNG or WebP, 15 MB at most as sent

oneOf.description:
Where it is on the map, as its page's map shows it, a car's or a property's alone (`deal`):
its own point, rounded to about a hundred metres as its form keeps it, or its town's; the
map draws a circle round it.

zone.description: Its zone in the town, for a property that says one: "Blloku".

zone_listings.description:
How many listings of its category its zone has on the site, those on sale at a price with
an area, which the zone's average comes from (`area_price.zone_per_m2`), as its page's note
counts them ("Mesatarja: 12 njoftime në shitje në Blloku"); none outside a zone, or in one
with too few for an average.

PlaceKind.description: What a suggested place is: a town, or a zone of one.

PlaceSuggestionDto.description:
A place the words lead to (`SuggestionsDto::places`): a search there (`city`, and `q` where
words go with it), all of its listings without them.

kind.description: A town; or a zone of one (`zone`), which the pages don't suggest yet.

q.description:
The words searched there: those typed before the town without the word that joins them to it
("golf" of "golf në durr"), or before that word after words joined to a place
("apartamente" of "apartamente në"); none for all of its listings ("durr").

slug.description: What names the town in a filter: "durres" (`city=durres`).

zone.description:
A zone's name, for a zone, in the town (whose zones `GET /cities` has, with their slugs);
none for a town.

Platform.description: The phone app's platform, which its push notifications go through: ios or android.

PriceDropDto.description: A listing kept whose price dropped, from what to what (`db::PriceDrop`).

from.description: What it was when the user last saw it, and what it is, as text ("32000", "29000").

id.description: The drop's own id, which `POST /saved/seen` takes as `up_to`: the first's, the latest.

no.description: The listing's number, which its card among `listings` has too.

amount.description:
The amount, as text, every digit it has ("9500", "12.5"); none for a price on request, nor
for a free one without.

per_month.description: Whether the amount is a month's: a rent's, or a job's pay.

type.description: How the price is meant: FIXED, NEGOTIABLE, FROM, FREE or ON_REQUEST.

was.description:
What it was, when it dropped lately (by a hundredth or more, within the last 30 days), as
text; the drop is worked out from the two.

PriceHintDto.description:
What cars of a model and year ask, for the posting form's hint under a car's price
(`GET /listings/price-hint`).

said.description:
The same in a sentence, where a price was typed: what the car's page will say of it, or, far
under them, that it may be wrong, or in the wrong currency.

text.description:
What they ask, in a sentence, in the listing's currency and the language asked for:
"Volkswagen Golf 2014–2018 në shitje: shumica kërkojnë 9 500–11 400 €, mesatarja 10 300 €."

oneOf.description:
How the price typed compares, as the car's page will judge it, as `ListingDto`'s
`car_price.verdict`: "good", "near" or "above"; null without a price, or for one so far under
them that it is likely wrong.

PriceType.description: How a listing's price is meant: FIXED, NEGOTIABLE, FROM (the price it starts from), FREE, or ON_REQUEST (no price given, agreed with the seller).

PromotionDto.description: A promotion on a listing now.

name.description: Its name, in the language asked for: "I veçuar për 7 ditë".

type.description: What it does: FEATURED, HIGHLIGHT, BUMP or CATEGORY_TOP.

ReadBody.description: What `POST /conversations/{id}/read` takes: the latest message the app showed, by its id.

ReasonDto.description: A reason a listing can be reported for (`GET /report/reasons`).

code.description: What a report says: SCAM, FAKE, PROHIBITED, SPAM, UNAVAILABLE, WRONG_DETAILS or OTHER.

hint.description: What it covers, which the form says under its name, likewise.

label.description: Its name, in Albanian and as an English page says it: "Mashtrim", "Scam".

serious.description:
Whether it counts towards taking the listing off the site: three people reporting it for one
of these do (SCAM, FAKE, PROHIBITED, SPAM); the others are for a moderator to look at.

RenameRequest.description: `PATCH /me`'s body: the name to show by, as typed.

ReportBody.description:
What `POST /listings/{no}/report` takes: one of the reasons' codes, and what the reporter adds,
which OTHER needs.

SavedDto.description: `GET /saved`: what the user keeps, as /te-ruajturat shows it.

gone.description:
The listings kept that no one can open any more, the last kept first, each to let go
(`DELETE /listings/{no}/saved`).

listings.description:
The listings kept that anyone can still open, the last kept first: those up, and those
reserved or sold since, which their `status` says.

price_drops.description:
The price drops of listings kept that the user hasn't seen yet, the latest first: what the
page shows over the listings, until `POST /saved/seen`.

SavedSeenBody.description:
What `POST /saved/seen` takes; in the OpenAPI document `SavedSeenBody`, notifications.rs having
a `SeenBody` of its own.

up_to.description: The latest price drop shown, by its id (`PriceDropDto::id`).

alerts.description:
Whether it tells of new listings: a notification, and an e-mail or a WhatsApp message where
its saver has one, at most one in three hours.

last_seen_at.description:
When it was last opened (its listings' first page, here; /kerkimet/{id} on the pages); null
until it is.

name.description:
What it shows by, as the pages name it, in Albanian whatever the language asked for: its
words, its page's category and what each filter's chip says, "„golf“ · Makina · Tiranë ·
Naftë", or "Të gjitha njoftimet".

oneOf.description:
How many listings came since it was last opened, or kept, up to 99, and whether more did
("99+"); null for one that no longer reads, its category gone.

path.description:
Its page, /search or a category's (/c/makina), and its filters as a query string in the
pages' vocabulary, which `/listings` takes too ("city=tirane&vehicle_fuel=DIESEL"; a
category's page's category is its path's).

SellerDto.description: Who sells a listing, as its page's seller card says.

oneOf.description:
When they were last on the site, by Albania's clock, by the days their card counts
(format::Activity): "today" ("Aktiv sot"), within the "week", from yesterday to six days
ago ("Aktiv dje", "Aktiv para 3 ditësh"), within the "month", up to thirty days ago, or
"longer" ago, the last two of which the card leaves unsaid; null for one never seen. A
store's, any of its people.

active_today.description: Whether they were on the site today, by Albania's clock: a store's, any of its people.

answers_within.description:
How quickly they usually answer, in words, in the language asked for ("brenda 1 ore",
"within an hour"); none until they had three conversations and answered half of them.

kind.description: A private seller ("user"), or a store ("business").

listings.description: How many listings they have up.

logo.description: A store's logo, its address absolute; none without one.

name.description: A store's name, or the private seller's.

since.description: Since when they have been on the site.

slug.description: A store's address, /biznes/{slug}; none for a private seller.

suspended.description:
Whether a moderator suspended their account or their store, which took the listing off the
site: its seller and the moderators, who alone see it then, are told so.

user_id.description:
The account that posted the listing (listings.created_by_user_id): a private seller's own,
whose profile is /perdorues/{user_id}, or one of a store's people. Blocking the seller
from the listing's page takes it (`PUT /sellers/{user_id}/blocked`), as the pages' block
does.

verified.description:
Whether the number or the address the listing shows is one its seller signed in with,
proved theirs by the code ("Numër i verifikuar").

SellerKind.description: Who sells a listing: a private seller (user), or a business.

SentDto.description:
A message written to a listing's seller (`POST /listings/{no}/messages`): the message's own
members, and the conversation it went into beside them.

SessionDto.description:
A device signed in to the account (`GET /me/sessions`): one of its sessions still good, as
"Cilësimet" counts them.

client.description: What signed it in: `web`, the pages, or the phone app, `ios` or `android`.

current.description: Whether it is the one asking: the session the bearer token names.

device_name.description: The phone's name, as the app gave it when it signed in; none for the pages.

last_used_at.description:
When it was last used, within ten minutes (it moves once ten minutes old); none until a
request used it.

first_time.description: Whether the account is new, made by this code.

token.description: The bearer token, given this once: the database keeps its hash alone.

user.description: Who signed in, as `/me` gives them.

Sort.description: The orders a list of listings comes in: relevance (the best match for the words first; only with words), newest, price_asc, price_desc, or nearest (to the pin first; only with one).

Status.description: Where a listing stands, as the database spells it: DRAFT (waiting for its seller's code), PENDING_REVIEW (waiting for a moderator), ACTIVE (up), PAUSED (down for a while, by its seller), RESERVED (up, and someone is taking it), SOLD (sold or let out, its page staying), EXPIRED (its time ran out), REJECTED (refused or taken off by a moderator), SUSPENDED (off the site for its reports, or with its seller's account), DELETED.

StoreDto.description: The store whose conversation it is, for one of its people: its address and its name.

SuggestionsDto.description:
`GET /suggestions`: what the words typed suggest, in the pages' order: the first of `words`,
then it in each of `categories`, then `options`, `places`, and the rest of `words`; each a
search the app runs through `GET /listings`.

categories.description:
The categories the first of `words` is found in most, two at most, each a search for it
there (`q` and `category`), but one where a make, model or brand of that very name is among
`options`, which finds it alone.

options.description:
The makes, models and brands whose names have words starting with each word typed, the
most used first, two at most, each in the category most of its listings are in.

places.description:
The towns the last word starts, a county's main town first, two at most; after words and the
word that joins them to a place ("apartamente në"), the towns those words have the most
listings in, three at most, and nothing else.

words.description:
Searches for words (`q`), three at most: the last word finished as listings use it, the
most used first, after the words before it ("golf" for "gol"; one that names one of
`places` left out, which its place searches), or for a whole word that seems misspelt the
word it most likely misspells ("mercedes" for "mercedez"); the words as typed where the
last is finished (a space after it) or isn't a word of letters ("golf 7"). None for words
too short (two letters in all), or after words joined to a place.

UploadDto.description:
A photo uploaded (`POST /photos`), waiting for a listing to name it: its id, its copies as a
listing's photos' are (`ListingDto`'s), its size and its tiny copy.

id.description: What a listing names it by (`photo_ids`, `cover`, `order`), and the listing's photo keeps.

placeholder.description: A tiny blurred copy as a data: URI, to show while one comes.

width.description: The whole photo's size in pixels, which every copy has the shape of.

ValidationDto.description:
The bounds the posting form holds a number to (`FieldDto::validation`), each where the property
has one.

WhyNotDto.description:
Why a message can't go (domain::messaging::Refusal): its code, the same in every language
(`Refusal::code`), and what it says (`Refusal::reason`).

slug.description: What names it in a filter, beside its town: "blloku" (`city=tirane&zone=blloku`).

ZoneGuessDto.description:
The zone a listing's words name, and its town, by their slugs; both null for none. In the
OpenAPI document `ZoneGuessDto`, reference.rs having a `ZoneDto` of its own.

ZoneVerdict.description: How a property's price per square metre compares with its zone's average: below (by 200 € or more), same (the same, as both show rounded), near (within 200 €), or above (by 200 € or more).

ZoneWordsDto.description: What `POST /listings/zone` takes: what the seller wrote, and the town chosen, if any.

city.description: The town's slug ("tirane"); none for a zone in a town the words name too.

bearer.description: The token `POST /api/v1/auth/verify` gives, given once, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: a session of the same table as the pages' cookie, a year long on a phone, which `POST /api/v1/auth/sign-out` ends, as signing out of the other devices does.

info.description: The JSON API the Pluribus phone app calls. Its paths start at the site's origin (`https://pluribus.al/api/v1/...`), which the client supplies. Albanian is the default language: `Accept-Language` (the first of its languages the site speaks) or `?lang=en` picks English, `?lang=sq` Albanian, and every answer says in `Vary` that it differs with `Accept-Language` and `Authorization`. A route that needs someone signed in takes the bearer token `POST /api/v1/auth/verify` gives, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (the `bearer` scheme); one where signing in is optional answers the signed-in caller otherwise, and 401 for a token no good session has. Whatever fails is answered in one envelope, `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields", "retry_after"}}` (`ErrorEnvelope`): `code` for the app to act on, the same in every language; `message` for a person to read, in the language asked for; `fields`, on a validation error alone, each field the request named with what is wrong with it; `retry_after`, on a request that came too soon, the seconds to wait where they are known. Amounts are text, every digit kept; times are RFC 3339, with their offset.
info.title: Pluribus API

post.description: Sends a sign-in code to a phone number or an e-mail address, as the pages send one and within their limits.
Ends the session the bearer token names, as signing out of the pages ends theirs: the token signs nothing in after.
Takes the code back and signs the account of its contact in, made if it had none, giving the bearer token once; the language the request asks for becomes the account's.

200.description: Signed in: the token, given this once, and the user

get.description: The whole tree of categories, each main one in the pages' order with those under it, as the welcome page and the posting form list them.

200.description: The main categories, each with those under it

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=300`: it may be kept five minutes

get.description: A category's properties, its own and those it takes from the categories above it, in its order, as its filters offer them, each with its place in the row of dropdowns its results page opens with where it has one, or as its posting form asks for them (none for the form of a category that only groups others).

parameters.description: `filters`, those its filters offer, or `form`, those its posting form asks for
parameters.name: for

200.description: The category's properties, in its order

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=300`: it may be kept five minutes

get.description: The towns listings go into, by county, each county's main town first, as the filters list them, each with its zones.

Cache-Control.description: `public, max-age=300`: it may be kept five minutes

get.description: The user's conversations, the latest written in first, as /mesazhet lists them, a store's among them for its people, 200 at most.
